dataset.name: MNIST
dataset.attribution: MNIST: Yann LeCun and Corinna Cortes; derived from NIST.
dataset.selection: Seed 13: 1000/class official training -> 900 train + 100 validation; 200/class official test. First 6 of each selected test class displayed before any training. One run; small architecture-inspired models.

models.name: LeNet-style
models.architecture: Conv6/5 tanh > AvgPool > Conv16/5 tanh > AvgPool > Dense120 > Dense84 > 10

models.name: Inception-style
models.architecture: Conv16 > Pool > 4 parallel branches > concat28 > Pool > Conv32 > Pool > Dense64 > 10

models.name: ResNet-style
models.architecture: Conv16 > Pool > residual16 > Pool > residual32 > Pool > Dense64 > 10

scope: Small teaching variants; five fixed epochs on one balanced MNIST subset. One seed/run; this is not a benchmark of the original named architectures.
